summary: The sample satisfies the core single-file dashboard contract and has a coherent operational layout, but the skill should force more audit-oriented data, better chart labeling, and workflow-connected UI states instead of static state examples only.
recommendations: Require run mock data to include started_at or updated_at timestamps and show them in the table and detail panel.
Require charts to include labels, legends, current value annotations, and time buckets so users can scan them without guessing.
Require filter/search to render an actual empty state when no rows match.
Require dark mode toggle to update its text and aria-pressed state.
Require detail panel to include trace steps with timestamps, failure evidence, and a recommended next action.
Clarify that state shelf is allowed, but loading/empty/error/partial/selected/stale must also appear in the main dashboard workflow when practical.
